children: NEW YORK, Sept 17 (Reuters) - The amount of U.S. commercial paper grew in the week ended Sept 16 Federal Reserve data showed on Thursday.    U.S. seasonally adjusted commercial paper outstanding rose $5.3 billion to $1.442 trillion in the latest week.    Non-seasonally adjusted commercial paper outstanding - which some analysts consider a more reliable reading than the seasonally adjusted one since it has been distorted by the financial crisis - rose $8.8 billion to $1.443 trillion.    U.S. non-seasonally adjusted foreign financial commercial paper outstanding rose $0.3 billion to $349.4 billion.
